scope: QIK-VRT artificial-cognitive input/output persistence, knowledge derivation, machine verification, and bounded automated publication
normative_requirement: Every semantically relevant item crossing a conforming artificial-cognitive input/output interface MUST be durably represented in the repository at suitable granularity with provenance. Qualifying derived knowledge MUST be evaluated for connectivity, machine-verifiable evidence, and publication eligibility. When all exact-head, evidence, rights, security, novelty, granularity, idempotency, credential, and external-effect preconditions are satisfied, the automation MUST materialize the qualified result as an exact-artifact-bound Zenodo publication and, when the result is protocol/specification material suitable for Internet standardization, as an IETF publication candidate or update through the repository's authorized IETF path.

io_coverage.rule: Coverage is semantic, not necessarily verbatim. Raw secrets, credentials, prohibited personal data, legally restricted material, non-publishable copyrighted payloads, and redundant transport noise MUST NOT be persisted merely to satisfy completeness. Instead persist a provenance-preserving typed receipt, digest, redaction marker, or reference sufficient for auditability whenever lawful and technically possible.

granularity.principle: Persist the smallest independently addressable work unit that preserves meaning, provenance, dependency edges, and reproducibility without fragmenting evidence into unusable noise.
granularity.deduplication: Content-address identical semantic payloads and reuse prior immutable evidence rather than duplicating it.
granularity.aggregation: Closely coupled events MAY be bundled when the bundle is the smallest unit that remains independently interpretable and verifiable.

new_knowledge_requires: semantic novelty or materially strengthened evidence
no promotion from owner assertion, model output, or resonance artifact to empirical fact without independent evidence
publication_is_not_required_for: unresolved speculation without a publishable evidence object
material whose rights status forbids the intended publication
duplicate knowledge already represented by an equivalent canonical artifact

machine_proof_boundary.formal_proof: A machine proof establishes derivability within its declared formal model and assumptions.
machine_proof_boundary.software_verification: Tests and executable receipts establish the tested software/evidence predicates only.
machine_proof_boundary.empirical_boundary: Neither formal proof nor software verification alone establishes independent physical correspondence or scientific consensus.
machine_proof_boundary.publication_claims: Published metadata MUST preserve these distinctions.

automation.external_effect: Allowed only after exact-artifact authorization, terminal applicable gates, credentials/permissions, idempotency check, rights/security review predicates, and reobservation immediately before effect.
automation.retry_policy: Idempotent retries only; never create duplicate Zenodo/IETF effects for the same publication identity and exact artifact.
automation.human_intervention: Not required for routine qualifying effects already covered by this standing delegation, but required whenever an applicable policy, rights, scientific-status, credential, or ambiguity gate explicitly requires human review.

zenodo.target: Qualified new knowledge and stable evidence artifacts

ietf.condition: Only when the knowledge object is protocol, interoperability, architecture, terminology, operational practice, or specification material suitable for the repository's IETF track.

forbidden: duplicate external publication caused by retry
publication that violates declared rights restrictions
claiming PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, repository equality, or scientific consensus without corresponding evidence
acceptance_criteria: Every conforming AI bootstrap loads this delegation.
Every semantically relevant I/O event produces either a durable repository-native work unit or an explicit typed exclusion/redaction receipt.
Persisted work units carry content identity, provenance, epistemic type, dependency edges, and reproducibility metadata appropriate to their modality.
The pipeline deterministically classifies semantic novelty and suitable granularity.
Qualifying claims are machine-verified to the strongest applicable proof/test level before publication eligibility is asserted.
Qualified publishable knowledge is automatically frozen, hashed, exact-head bound, and routed to Zenodo when all pre-effect gates are satisfied.
Protocol/specification-relevant qualified knowledge is additionally routed through the repository's IETF path when all applicable gates are satisfied.
Every external effect has a repository-native receipt and round-trip verification.
Unchanged semantic state is NOOP and retries are idempotent.
A browser HTTP GET of /AI is not falsely treated as a GitHub repository event; the semantic bootstrap client and repository-side scheduled/dispatch mechanisms are the execution triggers.
evidence_boundary: This delegation materializes the Product-Owner requirement and authorization. It does not itself prove that all executable capture, proof, Zenodo, or IETF adapters are already implemented or currently passing. Completion requires exact-head executable tests and effect receipts for the implemented pipeline.
